reviewer: builder (the agent session that wrote the generator)
iterations: v001: first massing. Shell rims reached 31.5 m; a camera fit to the traced podium showed the oblique puts them near 20 to 23 m.
v002: shells lowered; the east sheet now runs on under the west sheet as a ring on the oculus, as the oblique shows; meandering path and drifts started.

v003: shell walls lean in (0.28 m per metre of rise); loop path laid midway between the shells and the podium edge; meadow drifts; ground floor 6.0 m so the glazing is about as tall as the band; acoustic panels and two balcony rings in the hall.
v004: control radii became the walls' feet so the footprint stays on the measured outline; dark cap on the rims; the inferred roof hut replaced by a vestibule in the west shell.
v005: glazed door leaves in frames instead of an opaque block; the lip's outer wall in shell timber; lower flower clumps.
v006/v007: build report gains doors and auditorium counts; whole top view widened to keep the apron in frame. The GLB bytes are unchanged since v005.
findings: Plan follows the roof view: rounded podium 88 by 64.4 m (superellipse, n 3.3); oculus 23.8 by 18.8 m centred 11.4 m east and 1.7 m south of the podium centre; west shell from the north notch round the west and south; east shell from the south-east round the east to the notch; radial notch at the north with the west shell 1.4 m higher.

Oblique: the fitted camera (31 px RMS over 39 traced podium points) shows the podium band, recessed glazing, roof loop, the two rims meeting in a V at the back, the ring under the west shell and the hall through the oculus.
Heights: glazed ground floor 6.0 m, finned band to 11.2 m, roof garden 10.6 m, lip 12.4 m, west shell rim peak 23.6 m, east shell 21.6 m.

Openings: the curtain wall is set 1.0 m back under the band, with mullions every 4.8 m, a transom at 3.4 m, a sill, and a foyer behind it (cafe tables, counters, columns, a stair and the hall drum). Main doors, five glazed leaves in frames, at the south centre; four more at the east; an opaque back-of-house with a service door at the north-east.
Ribbon window in the band on the west end, set in a 0.35 m reveal with sill and head returns and rooms behind it.
Auditorium seen through the oculus: 11 raked tiers with seat strips facing an east stage, choir terraces, two balcony rings and vertical acoustic panels; about 340 stalls seats.

Roof garden: a winding loop midway between the shells and the guard, a south-west walk, spurs to the oculus lip and the west shell entrance, 2,600 low mounds in meadow and green drifts with pale flower clumps.
open_notes: Gate A: variant_2.png (the street view) is the grey preview of the old LEGO model. A person must rule that the oblique and roof views govern, or supply a street view.
The oblique puts the oculus about 8 m further west than the roof view; the model follows the roof view.
Image heights are weakly constrained: the camera fit changes by under 2 px RMS between an 11 m and a 21 m podium. The catalogue's two 5 m floors were used.
Interiors, the north and east ground floor, the roof entrance and the hall size are inferred. The hall is only as large as the oculus (about 340 stalls seats).
